annotations.title: Search Audited x402 & ERC-8004 API Directory

description: Search NullClear's audited x402 and ERC-8004 endpoint directory by keyword, category, minimum uptime, and maximum latency. Use this before paying external x402 sellers to find reliable APIs and retrieve their NullClear Zero-Loss Proxy URL (`https://api.nullclear.dev/https://...`). Returns matched endpoints with priceAtomic, uptimeScore, latencyMs, and proxy URL. Do NOT use to execute a call (pass the returned URL to nullclear_execute_escrow).

maxLatencyMs.description: Maximum acceptable edge round-trip latency in milliseconds (default 2000)

minUptime.description: Minimum rolling uptime percentage threshold from 0 to 100 (default 95)

query.description: Keyword filter matching endpoint URL or description (e.g. 'oracle', 'security', 'token', 'wallet')

verifiedOnly.description: When true, filter exclusively to canary-verified HTTP 402 endpoints (default true)

name: nullclear_discover_apis
